identity.result: OSM way 910910470 is the best directly named and addressed identity match for The Moosehead Lounge, 434 North Grant Street. The City of West Lafayette 2026-02-19 BPW closure map labels Moosehead Lounge at the same site. Purdue's CampusBuilding GIS name query contains no Moosehead match.

osm_source.feature: way 910910470; 22 boundary nodes; name=The Moosehead Lounge; addr:housenumber=434; addr:street=North Grant Street; building=semidetached_house; building:levels=2
osm_source.method: Used closed way ring for plan boundary; project conversion documented below.
osm_source.uncertainty: OSM naming/address tags are direct identity evidence but are community-maintained; not a Purdue-owned building identifier.

city_source.provider: City of West Lafayette, Board of Public Works
city_source.feature: Moosehead Lounge label on 2026-02-19 closure map
city_source.source_date: 2026-02-19, date shown in map filename/title context
city_source.source_crs: Map display; not a coordinate dataset
city_source.method: Visual label/site check against 434 N Grant Street and OSM footprint location.
city_source.uncertainty: Supports site identity only; map is not a building footprint or elevation source.

purdue_gis_source.feature: Name query snapshot in sources/purdue_moosehead_name_query.json; no Moosehead name match
purdue_gis_source.source_date: Not supplied by the layer response
purdue_gis_source.uncertainty: No direct Purdue GIS feature was identified. Do not assign FID 855: the assignment table maps FID 855 to the Old Purdue Exponent Building, so this is a conflicting candidate and is excluded.

footprint.selected_geometry_reason: Named/addressed footprint matches the assigned Moosehead identity and site label, and its bbox agrees with the existing manifest campus bounds. No reliable Purdue CampusBuilding name match was found.
footprint.projection: Project's local approximate conversion: X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040.0. This is a local approximation, not a surveyed CRS.
footprint.measurement_method: Shapely planar polygon area/intersection after projecting source WGS84 rings with the documented local conversion; results rounded to 0.01 m2.

indiana_2018_candidate.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana Building Footprints 2016-2020 layer
indiana_2018_candidate.source_crs: WGS 84 geographic coordinates (EPSG:4326) in query result; service metadata reports Web Mercator (EPSG:3857)
indiana_2018_candidate.conflict: The 2018 lidar footprint extends well south of the OSM Moosehead outline across the adjacent roof. It overlaps most of the OSM footprint but is nearly 2.5 times its area; the high overlap is not sufficient to treat it as a clean identity match.
indiana_2018_candidate.uncertainty: The imagery comparison suggests a merged/adjacent roof polygon. The exact historic segmentation and wall line remain unresolved; this feature is not used as the target shell.

height_and_roof.status: Estimated schematic dimensions. OSM lists two building levels but no measured elevation was found.
height_and_roof.uncertainty: Exact eave, ridge, roof divisions, and facade dimensions are unverified.

imagery.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana Current Imagery
imagery.source_date: Imagery service covers 2022-2025; exact acquisition date for the exported tile not resolved from saved metadata.
imagery.method: Visual check of OSM outline and Indiana 2018 footprint against current orthophoto; 0.0762 m pixel size in service metadata.
imagery.uncertainty: Orthophoto supports horizontal roof context, not wall/eave height or facade details.

roof_interpretation.source: Indiana Current Imagery roof context at sources/indiana_current_imagery_site.tif; RGB preview at sources/orthophoto_preview.png; registered overlay at sources/current_imagery_footprint_overlay.png
roof_interpretation.observation: The orthophoto shows multiple roof planes over the named OSM footprint, with an offset east/south wing and a visible roof break near the footprint's stepped east transition. The image does not resolve vertical dimensions.
r2_geometry_changes: Replace one broad uniform gable with two adjacent roof zones clipped to the OSM structural ring: a west/north body and an east/south wing.
Add two terminal gable-end wall faces above the eaves and a narrow transition wall at the shared roof break to close the roof profiles.
Retain 5.25 m eaves and 7.60 m ridge as estimates; both roof zones use the same estimated ridge height because no elevation source supports a height difference.
roof_interpretation.measurement_method: Roof-zone seam placed approximately at local X=310.95 m, where the OSM ring steps into the east/south wing. Ridge Y is approximated from each clipped plan zone's north/south bounds. This is an interpretive massing method, not a measured ridge line.
roof_interpretation.uncertainty: Orthophoto shadows/tree cover obscure some seams; exact roof edges, ridge positions, gable profiles, and heights remain unverified. Facade imagery/elevations were not found, so generic windows and trim were removed; only OSM level-0 entry nodes remain as plain schematic doors.

result: Keep OSM way 910910470 as the selected named footprint source; retain the Indiana 2018 shape as an explicit conflicting/merged candidate; leave Purdue FID unresolved and exclude FID 855.
